How to enable 2-Step Verification

06

Share Your Google Calendar

So our Flairlabs scheduling agent can book seller calls directly onto your calendar, share it with c.huaman@sell2rent.com using "Make changes and manage sharing" permission.

How to share your calendar
  1. 1In the left sidebar under "My calendars," hover over your calendar name and click the three-dot menu.
  2. 2Select "Settings and sharing."
  3. 3Under "Share with specific people," click "Add people and groups," enter c.huaman@sell2rent.com, set Permissions to "Make changes and manage sharing," and click "Send."

Video 03 — Seller Manager Role

Your Role, and a Welcome from Merinda, VP of Sales

Daily responsibilities, core processes, and how this role guides homeowners through their journey — plus a personal welcome and mission briefing from leadership (~2 min).

Watch Video →
Read the transcript

Hey, welcome to the team! You're joining Sell2Rent Sales, and we are really excited to have you on board.

You're now part of a team that's changing how homeowners navigate difficult financial situations — and how investors get access to opportunities they wouldn't otherwise see.

Your mission is simple: connect with homeowners and guide them through one of the most stressful moments of their lives — whether it's foreclosure, divorce, medical debt, or just trying to catch a financial break. Your job isn't just to hit numbers. It's to listen, understand where they're at, and know exactly how to help. You're the expert in that room. Speak with empathy. Lead with confidence.

Let's get real: most of the people you talk to are scared, frustrated, or just tired. That's why it's crucial to stay calm, professional, and focused on the outcome — a fresh start for them. Even when a deal doesn't work out, remember: you're not just selling a house. You're building trust, stability, and a bridge to their next chapter.

Now, let's talk about what's expected here. We aim for excellence. We don't cut corners, and we don't make excuses. If you don't know something, ask. If you hit a wall, speak up. You're surrounded by a team that wins through collaboration, not competition. We're here to solve problems — not just close deals.

At Sell2Rent, we're not just another real estate company. We're the real deal, for real people. So again — welcome. Bring your energy, your curiosity, and your drive. Let's help homeowners get back on their feet, and let's make Sell2Rent the standard of excellence in this industry. We're not here to be average. We're here to make a difference. Let's get to work.

Transcript lightly cleaned up for readability.

Step 3 — Your Pay & Schedule

How You Get Paid

Your compensation structure, in plain terms. Full legal detail lives in your Independent Contractor Agreement.

New Hire Ramp Period
100%
Your first 3 full calendar months, you get 100% of your guaranteed Base Pay — no matter what you produce. Starting month 4, the tiered structure below kicks in.
Standard Base Pay
$2,500/mo
Your guaranteed monthly base, subject to the performance tiers below once your ramp period ends.
Commission
3%
Of Net Revenue on every transaction you close. Flat rate, every month — no tiers or caps on the rate itself.
Top Performer Bonus
$250
Only for the single highest-performing Seller Manager companywide in a given month — and only if that person also hits 70%+ of goal.
Pre-Assignment Bonus
$150
For every qualifying lead you pre-assign to an Investor Advisor, once the associated property closes. Paid the month after it closes.

Base Pay by Performance Tier (starting month 4)

Monthly Revenue Achieved0–25%26–49%50–69%70–100%
Next Month's Base Pay0%50%75%100%

Your Schedule

  • 1Rotating schedule, including holidays
  • 2Weekend work required, with compensated time off during the week to offset weekend shifts
  • 3One paid day off per month
  • 4Vacation time in accordance with the Company's standard vacation policy
